subject.title: WhatsApp channel: expose ctwa_clid from Click-to-WhatsApp ads in session metadata

question: Should WhatsApp CTWA attribution data be exposed only as per-turn untrusted context, also passed to plugin hooks, or durably stored on session metadata for later Conversions API use?
rationale: The extraction is technically clear, but `ctwa_clid` is an ad attribution identifier and the issue requests prompt/session visibility, so automation should not choose the privacy and retention boundary.

options.title: Per-turn untrusted context
options.body: Extract the CTWA fields in the WhatsApp plugin and expose them only through the existing fenced untrusted structured-context prompt path.

options.title: Plugin-hook attribution payload
options.body: Define a typed WhatsApp attribution payload for opted-in plugin hooks so a Conversions API plugin can consume it without putting the identifier into every agent prompt.

options.title: Persist session attribution
options.body: Store the first CTWA payload on session state only after defining retention, redaction, and access rules.

recommendation.title: Per-turn untrusted context
recommendation.body: Extract the CTWA fields in the WhatsApp plugin and expose them only through the existing fenced untrusted structured-context prompt path.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining decision spans prompt visibility, security posture, and session metadata, all areas in recent adjacent history.
